label: the phone camera (the keyframes)

the_crop.note: the picture is CUT to the corpus's aspect and then resized; a stretched picture moves every cell and the grid is positional

the_luma_spec.note: the corpus's own luma geometry, so experiments/lens.py computes this channel's change map unchanged

the_units_note: THIS CHANNEL IS IN THE SAME UNITS AS THE PROART'S, because it IS the camera's own luma rather than the room-lens's posterised brightness: one scale is honest between the two views, and this is the only pairing of the phone's two channels where that is true

the_clock_anchor.the_source: DERIVED from the bundle's own wall stamps
the_clock_anchor.the_note: the walkabout's start, recovered from the audio parts' and the room measures' own wall clocks. meta.startedAt is the SESSION's creation time, which here is 435.840 s earlier, and it is NOT the origin of the frames' t.

the_pose.the_note: the device orientation attached to every frame
the_pose.the_what_this_does_not_license: there is NO POSITION in the pose, so the device cannot be placed in the room, and the heading is null, so its azimuth is unknown: a relative pose against another view cannot be solved from this bundle, and the SCALE certainly is not in it

the_noise_of_this_sensor.the_note: THE CORPUS'S OWN FLOOR, because this channel IS the corpus's construction: 160x96 luma, the 4x4 block mean, the same units the ProArt's change map is in. The ASCII channel's floor was a different number because the ASCII channel is a different quantity.

the_signal_threshold.the_rule: the threshold at which this channel is on 90 % of its frames: the 10th percentile of its per-frame change-map maxima
the_signal_threshold.the_convention: nearest rank: the k-th smallest observed per-frame maximum, k = ceil((1 - duty) * n) = 11
the_signal_threshold.the_note: A SIGNAL THRESHOLD, NOT A GRAIN FLOOR. The floor asks "is there anything here at all"; this asks "is this channel reading the room". It is a property of THIS recording, so it is measured here and not borrowed.
the_signal_threshold.the_crossing_detector_note: the corpus's OWN crossing detector, with this channel's own frame offsets, so the gap is counted in this channel's own frames and not in the corpus's 60 fps

the_note: the camera's own luma, from the keyframes the room-lens already banked. This is the second way the phone can be read, and the one that puts the two views in the same units.
